prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one 74x100 target-scale dialogue portrait for a gritty low-fantasy RPG. Substantive portrait redraw of the single established character, NOT a crop or resize of old art.
Input image roles: image 1 is ONLY the character's identity and costume reference. Images 2-5 are STYLE references only: Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore. Follow their coarse hard-edged portrait pixel clusters, not their face or expression.
Composition: tall 74:100 image, one very large adult head in subtle three-quarter view facing viewer-left, crown at 3% height, chin at 88%. Only a very short neck and narrow collar in the bottom 10%. Entire crown, ears, hair/head covering and side silhouette stay inside with a small clean transparent margin. No spread shoulders, chest, torso, hands, props or frame. Head/face must fill the space, not a small head over a bust.
Style: large coherent opaque pixel clusters for brow ridge, nose bridge, nostril wings, cheekbone, cheek, temple, jaw, lower eyelid. Strong adult bone structure and visible stepped silhouette. Approximately 24-32 flat low-saturation colors, warm ochre skin, deep reddish-brown shadows. No anti-aliasing, airbrush, gradient, glossy skin, noise, dithering, speckles, isolated hair strands, fragmented beard, soft painterly edges. Small dark adult eyes with at most a tiny muted sclera accent, NEVER bright white large eyes. No chibi/anime features or generic raised sorrow brows.
Identity: BENO, MAE-NPC-BENO, a male ordinary nursing-shift intake worker about thirty years old. Preserve his broad sturdy adult face and broad squared jaw, straight broad nose, warm weathered skin, short dark-brown tousled hair simplified into five or six joined chunky masses, and compact closely trimmed brown beard/moustache as connected large dark planes. Full beard remains short and close, not long or scraggly. Alert but calm practical scrutiny, horizontal thick brows with slight asymmetry, closed firm mouth. Not smiling, not grieving or angry; reliable and bounded, capable of saying this shift is full. Keep adult age around thirty, no gray, not elderly. A narrow muted deep-blue plain nursing-workshirt collar and tiny off-white linen apron strap are the only clothes at the bottom. Do not add medical emblems, jewellery, uniform rank or props. Separate this round broad practical face from Tore's longer, gaunt worried face.
Background genuinely transparent. Exactly one standalone portrait, no labels or extra objects.
